test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 24 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Which neighbouring country has emerged as the top destination of wheat exports from India in 2020-21, with the largest share of over 54 per cent both in terms of quantity and value?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangladesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Bangladesh is a very close neighbor of India, and shares a very long border.
 
• The Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA) reports confirmed this fact.
 
• The significant wheat export to Bangladesh highlights the strong trade relationship between the two countries.
 
• Geographical proximity plays a key role in facilitating this trade.
 
• Bangladesh's dependence on wheat imports makes India a crucial supplier.
 
• The trade relationship supports food security in Bangladesh.
 
• The high percentage of exports reflects a strong demand for Indian wheat in Bangladesh.
 
• This trade also benefits Indian farmers and exporters.
 
• The export of wheat is an important part of the economic relationship between the two nations.
 
• The large percentage indicates that more than half of India's wheat export, went to Bangladesh.
 
• This trade relationship has continued in the years following 2020-2021.
 
• The close trade relationship helps to create stability in the region.
 
• The export of food products is a very important part of international trade.
 
• The export of wheat helps to create jobs in India.
 
• The quality of Indian wheat is a reason for the high demand.
 
• The price of Indian wheat is also a factor in the high demand.
 
• The ease of transport, between the two nations, also helps.
 
• The trade in wheat helps to strengthen the diplomatic relationship between the nations.
 
• The export of wheat is an important source of foreign currency for India.
 
• The large amount of exports shows the importance of agriculture to the Indian economy.
